import csv
from collections import defaultdict

# Key series
z201_temp = 'baef86cb-2941-5d61-87b0-ffa91d79f23a'
z201_sp  = '1213f3a8-c23d-55b5-8187-4712d49a82ae'
z301_temp = 'e0dd5f44-f050-5faa-a2a0-a3fcb6284ae8'
z301_sp  = '5b98cbc1-fd25-5d8c-a96e-c3de49819174'
z401_temp = '14a08406-79a0-52ca-b8a1-8563259dc820'
z401_sp  = '22de734e-0a64-57ec-a6a5-f288ee06f947'

all_ids = {z201_temp, z201_sp, z301_temp, z301_sp, z401_temp, z401_sp}

data = defaultdict(dict)
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        if r['timeseries_id'] in all_ids:
            data[r['timeseries_id']][r['timestamp']] = float(r['value'])

print("Timestamps for z201_sp:", sorted(data.get(z201_sp,{}).keys())[:5], "...", sorted(data.get(z201_sp,{}).keys())[-5:])
print("n z201_temp:", len(data.get(z201_temp,{})))
print("n z201_sp:", len(data.get(z201_sp,{})))

# Show daily averages around mid June 2018
from datetime import datetime

def period_stats(ts_series, start, end, hour_range=None):
    vals = []
    for ts, v in ts_series.items():
        dt = datetime.strptime(ts, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
        if start <= dt <= end:
            if hour_range is None or hour_range[0] <= dt.hour < hour_range[1]:
                vals.append(v)
    return sum(vals)/len(vals) if vals else None, len(vals)

start_before = datetime(2018,5,20)
end_before = datetime(2018,6,14,23,59,59)
start_after  = datetime(2018,6,15)
end_after  = datetime(2018,7,20,23,59,59)

hour_range = (8, 18)  # occupied hours

for label, (tsp_s, sps) in [
    ("Z201", (data.get(z201_temp,{}), data.get(z201_sp,{}))),
    ("Z301", (data.get(z301_temp,{}), data.get(z301_sp,{}))),
    ("Z401", (data.get(z401_temp,{}), data.get(z401_sp,{}))),
]:
    t_before, n1 = period_stats(tsp_s, start_before, end_before, hour_range)
    t_after,  n2 = period_stats(tsp_s, start_after,  end_after,  hour_range)
    sp_before, s1 = period_stats(sps, start_before, end_before, hour_range)
    sp_after,  s2 = period_stats(sps, start_after,  end_after,  hour_range)
    print(f"{label}: temp before={t_before:.3f} (n={n1}), after={t_after:.3f} (n={n2}), diff={t_after-t_before:.3f}")
    print(f"{label}: sp  before={sp_before:.3f} (n={s1}), after={sp_after:.3f} (n={s2}), diff={sp_after-sp_before:.3f}")
